review: Reviewed complete GCN account component and both browser suites, shared credential/status/private lease schemas, account cache identity, relevant account route and credential/private-access service behavior. No copied provider data or third-party asset is included.

Public catalog use, personal encrypted credentials, unavailable public managed-source allowance, explicit private source qualification, optional reasoning and Discord delivery remain distinct. The private form advertises the configured finite window and 64-notice limit, without public enrollment, subscriber debit, reasoning or posting authority.

Reproduced eight failures: another-owner status was displayed; pending credential writes were not aborted on account change/unmount; refreshing preserved old approval; malformed, changed-expiry or wrong-mode private receipts were accepted; pending private activation was not aborted on account change.

Status now must match cached account identity; writes recheck it and carry the expected profile. One mutation controller prevents concurrent dispatch, preserves the 15-second timeout, and is aborted on account changes/unmount. Old finalizers cannot clear a newer request. Credential drafts still clear before submission and never enter browser storage.

Private review clears on refresh and on submission. A successful HTTP status alone cannot claim activation or Stop: the bounded receipt must contain the reviewed active mode/expiry or no active leases for Stop. An expired displayed window asks for a new status review without sending a write. Provider connection readiness remains separate.

Fifteen browser tests and nine canonical account/private-service tests pass. Server tests use in-memory PostgreSQL, synthetic encryption material, mocked ingestion/identities and loopback request handlers; they do not connect to NASA, save actual user secrets or operate a production worker.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; no installation, real GCN credential, provider connection, managed allowance, paid reasoning or Discord delivery was exercised.

The UI verifies the returned lease against the displayed expiry. Operator configuration changes between review and the server write remain separate qualification: the existing request contract carries expected profile, mode, accept and policy, not an expected-expiry field.

Server route/session checks, encrypted storage, configured private eligibility, credential-revision fencing, 64-record intake, expiry and worker-authentication tests are supporting canonical evidence. Their service code and shared contracts remain separately selected dependencies, not web-preview exports in this cohort.
Native/provider custody, account initialization on the installed surface, real timeout/stop delivery and the matching deployed site require installed/live acceptance.
Star Watcher retained-source changes remain held until its other integration dependencies are reviewed. Five inherited intentional support-contact matches remain in owner publication review.
